Class User

java.lang.Object
Actors.User
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, Employee, Student
public abstract class User extends Object implements Serializable
Abstract base class for every account in the university system.

Encapsulates identity (username, full name) and credentials (SHA-256 password hash). Subclasses represent concrete roles: Admin, Student, Teacher, Manager, Dean, Rector.

The showMenu(java.util.Scanner, Services.Services) method implements the Template Method pattern: it drives the common menu loop and delegates role-specific items to the abstract methods printRoleSpecificMenu() and handleRoleSpecificChoice(String, java.util.Scanner, Services.Services).

Common functionality available to all users regardless of role: profile management, news viewing, researcher directory, research paper search, peer-to-peer messaging, and full-text public search.

Research operations (manageResearch(Scanner, Services), publish paper, create/join project, view projects, update h-index) are also implemented here so that both Student and Employee subtypes share one code path without duplication. Methods cast this to IResearcher at runtime; this is always safe because they are only reachable when IResearcher.isResearcher() returns true. Researcher status is granted and revoked exclusively by Admin.

Equality and hashing are based solely on username.
